cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include(cmkr.cmake OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cmake.toml)
endif()

# Variables
set(FETCHCONTENT_UPDATES_DISCONNECTED ON)

project(maf
	LANGUAGES
		C
		CXX
	VERSION
		0.1.0
	DESCRIPTION
		"A simple programming language."
)

include("cmake/llvm.cmake")

include(FetchContent)

# Fix warnings about DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP
if(POLICY CMP0135)
	cmake_policy(SET CMP0135 NEW)
endif()
message(STATUS "Fetching cute (main)...")
FetchContent_Declare(cute
	GIT_REPOSITORY
		"https://github.com/Ryooooooga/cute"
	GIT_TAG
		main
	GIT_SHALLOW
		ON
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(cute)

# Target: ${PROJECT_NAME}-cflags
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-cflags INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(${PROJECT_NAME}-cflags INTERFACE
	c_std_23
)

target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME}-cflags INTERFACE
	-Wall
	-Wextra
	-Wpedantic
	-Werror
)

# Target: ${PROJECT_NAME}-static
set(${PROJECT_NAME}-static_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
	"src/arena.c"
	"src/malloc.c"
)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME}-static STATIC)

target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME}-static PRIVATE ${${PROJECT_NAME}-static_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${${PROJECT_NAME}-static_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME}-static PUBLIC
	include
)

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME}-static PUBLIC
	${PROJECT_NAME}-cflags
	llvm
)

set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME}-static PROPERTIES
	OUTPUT_NAME
		${PROJECT_NAME}
)

# Target: ${PROJECT_NAME}-exe
set(${PROJECT_NAME}-exe_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
	"maf/main.c"
)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME}-exe)

target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME}-exe PRIVATE ${${PROJECT_NAME}-exe_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${${PROJECT_NAME}-exe_SOURCES})

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME}-exe PRIVATE
	${PROJECT_NAME}-cflags
	${PROJECT_NAME}-static
)

set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME}-exe PROPERTIES
	OUTPUT_NAME
		${PROJECT_NAME}
)

get_directory_property(CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
if(NOT CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
	set_property(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT ${PROJECT_NAME}-exe)
endif()

set(${PROJECT_NAME}-test_SOURCES
	cmake.toml

if(NOT CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
	set_property(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT ${PROJECT_NAME}-test)
endif()
